title: Digital green transformation of network infrastructure based on artificial intelligence
summary: China Telecom reports 900 million kWh in annual savings, over 500,000 tons less CO₂, and 90% lower energy-system deployment and operating costs.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: China Telecom describes an AI-powered control and operations platform across millions of mobile-network sectors, equipment rooms, and servers. It reports annual energy and emissions reductions and substantial operating savings. These are aggregate first-party claims. The source does not provide the underlying accounting data or isolate the contribution of each technical component.
purpose: Reduce telecom infrastructure energy use and improve operations.
system: Digital green transformation of network infrastructure based on artificial intelligence

ratings.reason: China Telecom reports 900 million kWh annual energy savings and 90% lower energy-system deployment/operating costs across its network.
The submission claims an annual CO₂ reduction of more than 500,000 tons, a measurable aggregate footprint improvement without independently checked accounting in this review.

ai_role.statement: The contributor describes the system and its proposed or reported contribution. This collection entry does not independently isolate the effect of AI from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 15: Digital green transformation of network infrastructure based on artificial intelligence

produced_by: The contributor describes the application and its setting in the cited entry. Conditions sufficient to reproduce the reported benefit have not been established.
must_hold: Requirements for reproducing the benefit need to be evaluated in the new setting. The collection entry does not establish that its reported results will recur.

headline: Telecom AI reports large energy and operating-cost savings

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
